shots.line: A brand offers you three hundred dollars for ten AI videos by Friday. You've never made one.
Option A: say yes, and figure it out by Friday.
Option B: pass, practice for a month, and pitch them later. Most people pick B.
I'd pick A, and here's the one thing that makes A safe. Comment A or B. Part two shows what happened.
Real or AI? Your client paid two hundred dollars to find out.
They say the video looks fake, and they want a refund.
A: refund the two hundred dollars and move on.
B: redo it free, but fix the three things that give AI away. Comment A or B. Tomorrow I show the fix.
Send this to the friend who just lost their job. One phone, zero dollars.
A: apply to fifty jobs this week.
B: spend the week learning to make AI product videos for tiktok shop sellers.
Both are real. Only one pays this month. Comment A or B, and tag the friend.
